newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Overnight guilders ease a touch in quiet session.
newsitem.headline: Overnight guilders ease a touch in quiet session.

text.p: Overnight guilders eased a touch in routine trade on Monday, but dealers said overall there was little inter-bank activity.
Call money was quoted between 3.06 and 3.25 percent bid, with most trade being done at around 3.12 and 3.18 percent, dealers said. On Friday, call was trading at 3.19-25 percent.
One- to three-month guilders were up a touch, quoting at 3.20/28 bid/offer while longer-dated money rates were unmoved.
One trader said that early in the session there had been some heavy bidding in one-month money, causing it to change hands at 3.28 percent. But later prices had come back into line.
The guilder was trading around 112.50 per 100 marks on Monday, well-nigh unchanged from Friday's 112.505 fixing.
